title: Nice streamline look
text: Nice streamline look. Big letters for reading in the daytime, but you can't read them at night. The numbers don't light up, which I consider a major feature in a digital clock.

product_metadata.title: La Crosse Technology WS-6002U-A Atomic Digital Wall Clock
features: Radio-controlled digital wall clock; accurate to the second
Displays indoor temperature, and day of the week
Dual LCD screens and modes for 12- or 24-hour time modes
Displays in Fahrenheit or Celsius, and in English, French, or Spanish
2-1/4-inch number display for easy reading; measures 8.35 inches square and 1 inch deep
description: This radio-controlled digital wall clock automatically synchronizes itself with the U.S. Atomic Clock for down-to-the-second accuracy. The clock displays data in either 12- or 24-hour time modes. Days of the week appear in English, French, or Spanish. The handy device also tracks moon phases and displays indoor temperature in Fahrenheit or Celsius. The clock also falls back and springs forward on its own, adjusting for Standard and Daylight Savings Time so there's no more missing appointments or showing up to parties an hour early once a year. A modern, handsome design complements any decor. The 2-14-inch, digital display is large enough to see across a room.
